name: bollard-harness
docker_compose_file:
# dstack runs this compose file inside the CVM. The image MUST be referenced by digest, so the compose hash
# fixes exactly which harness code holds an enclave key.
services:
  harness:
    image: ghcr.io/bollardrh/bollard-harness@sha256:REPLACE_WITH_RELEASE_DIGEST
    restart: always
    environment:
      ROLE: harness
      CHAIN_ID: "46630"
      RHC_RPC_URL: https://rpc.testnet.chain.robinhood.com
      COORDINATOR_URL: ${COORDINATOR_URL}
      # pinned in the compose (and so in the compose hash), never operator-supplied
      ATTESTERS_RHC: "0x6959413B747643Fd070c6A541354DB3FE9e6975a"
      REGISTRY_RHC: "0x016889569C0A52Ea1B1ffa428E2fe346d36212dF"
      ATTESTER_ADDRESS: ${ATTESTER_ADDRESS}
      HOLDOUT_PATH: /holdout/holdout.enc
      HOLDOUT_KEY: ${HOLDOUT_KEY}
      APP_COMPOSE_PATH: /app/app-compose.json
    volumes:
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
      - /dstack/app-compose.json:/app/app-compose.json:ro
      - holdout:/holdout:ro
volumes:
  holdout:
